sections.heading: on the reconfirmation of the authorisation of the European Union military operation in the Mediterranean (EUNAVFOR MED IRINI) (EUNAVFOR MED IRINI/5/2026)

paras.text: THE POLITICAL AND SECURITY COMMITTEE,
paras.loc: on the reconfirmation of the authorisation of the European Union military operat, para 1

paras.text: Having regard to the Treaty on European Union, and in particular Article 38 thereof,
paras.loc: on the reconfirmation of the authorisation of the European Union military operat, para 2

paras.text: Having regard to Council Decision (CFSP) 2020/472 of 31 March 2020 on a European Union military operation in the Mediterranean (EUNAVFOR MED IRINI) ( 1 ) , and in particular Article 8(3) thereof,
paras.loc: on the reconfirmation of the authorisation of the European Union military operat, para 3

paras.text: Whereas:
paras.loc: on the reconfirmation of the authorisation of the European Union military operat, para 4
on the reconfirmation of the authorisation of the European Union military operat, para 5

paras.text: On 31 March 2020, the Council adopted Decision (CFSP) 2020/472, which established and launched a European Union military operation in the Mediterranean (EUNAVFOR MED IRINI).
paras.loc: on the reconfirmation of the authorisation of the European Union military operat, para 6
on the reconfirmation of the authorisation of the European Union military operat, para 7

paras.text: Decision (CFSP) 2020/472 provides that the authorisation of EUNAVFOR MED IRINI is to be reconfirmed every four months and that the Political and Security Committee (PSC) is to prolong the operation unless the deployment of maritime assets of the operation produces a pull effect on migration, on the basis of substantiated evidence gathered according to the criteria set in the Operations Plan.
paras.loc: on the reconfirmation of the authorisation of the European Union military operat, para 8
on the reconfirmation of the authorisation of the European Union military operat, para 9

paras.text: On 9 October 2026, the Council adopted Decision (CFSP) 2026/2243 ( 2 ) , which extended EUNAVFOR MED IRINI until 31 March 2029.
paras.loc: on the reconfirmation of the authorisation of the European Union military operat, para 10
on the reconfirmation of the authorisation of the European Union military operat, para 11

paras.text: On 16 July 2026, the PSC adopted Decision (CFSP) 2026/1884 ( 3 ) , which reconfirmed the authorisation of EUNAVFOR MED IRINI until 30 November 2026.
paras.loc: on the reconfirmation of the authorisation of the European Union military operat, para 12
on the reconfirmation of the authorisation of the European Union military operat, para 13

paras.text: The EU Operation Commander for EUNAVFOR MED IRINI has provided monthly reports on the pull effect on migration of the operation.
paras.loc: on the reconfirmation of the authorisation of the European Union military operat, para 14
on the reconfirmation of the authorisation of the European Union military operat, para 15

paras.text: The authorisation of EUNAVFOR MED IRINI should be reconfirmed for the twenty-first four-month sub-period of its mandate and the operation should be prolonged accordingly,
paras.loc: on the reconfirmation of the authorisation of the European Union military operat, para 16

paras.text: HAS ADOPTED THIS DECISION:
paras.loc: on the reconfirmation of the authorisation of the European Union military operat, para 17

paras.text: The authorisation of the European Union military operation in the Mediterranean (EUNAVFOR MED IRINI) is hereby reconfirmed and the operation is prolonged from 1 December 2026 to 31 March 2027.
paras.loc: Article 1, para 1

paras.text: This Decision shall enter into force on the date of its adoption.
paras.loc: Article 2, para 1

paras.text: Done at Brussels, 24 November 2026.
paras.loc: Article 2, para 2
